app_info.subtitle: Build and run browser flows
app_info.description: Puppetflow helps users create, run, schedule, and monitor browser automations, manage reusable flow snippets, inspect execution results, and retrieve generated artifacts from ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches flow metadata visible to the connected user without changing any flow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads data from the user's private Puppetflow workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, publish, or execute flows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one flow's configuration and Flow Inputs without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads data from the user's private Puppetflow workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter the flow or start an execution.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the editable code or visual graph of a flow without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private flow source from Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite or execute the returned source.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists accessible Puppetflow folders without changing their contents.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace organization data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, move, or delete folders.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves allowed scopes, teams, folders, and defaults for flow creation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads configuration from the user's Puppetflow workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create a flow or change workspace configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the generated catalog of available Puppetflow nodes and runtime helpers.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses only Puppetflow's local framework catalog.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create or modify flows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists workspace resources that an accessible flow or snippet may reference.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private resource metadata from Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change or expose the underlying resource values.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a JavaScript flow or updates an existing flow draft.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores source inside Puppetflow and does not execute it or write to third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: An update overwrites the selected flow's current draft after a concurrency check.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a visual flow or updates an existing flow graph.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores the graph inside Puppetflow and does not execute it or affect third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: An update overwrites the selected flow's current draft after a concurrency check.

justifications.read_only_justification: Publishes the current flow draft as a version in Puppetflow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Publication is limited to Puppetflow access controls and does not post to the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Version history is retained and publication does not delete the draft.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a flow's publication state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes availability within Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Keeps the draft and version history so the flow can be published again.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists cron and webhook trigger metadata without returning webhook tokens.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads trigger configuration from Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not enable, update, or delete triggers.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an active or inactive cron or webhook trigger for a flow.
justifications.open_world_justification: An active cron trigger can run browser automation that affects external websites.
justifications.destructive_justification: A scheduled execution may cause external side effects that cannot be retracted after it runs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates the schedule, inputs, scope, or active state of a flow trigger.
justifications.open_world_justification: Enabling or changing a cron trigger can cause browser automation to run against external websites.
justifications.destructive_justification: It overwrites trigger configuration and scheduled executions may have irreversible external effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a selected flow trigger from Puppetflow.
justifications.open_world_justification: The deletion only changes Puppetflow's private trigger configuration.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the trigger and stops its future executions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists post-run action metadata while redacting webhook secrets and values.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads action configuration from Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not invoke, update, or delete an action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a post-run webhook action for a flow.
justifications.open_world_justification: An active action sends future flow results to the configured external webhook.
justifications.destructive_justification: A webhook delivery caused by a later run cannot be retracted after it is sent.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates a post-run webhook action and its delivery settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: An enabled action sends future flow results to an external webhook.
justifications.destructive_justification: It overwrites action configuration and completed webhook deliveries cannot be retracted.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes a selected post-run action from Puppetflow.
justifications.open_world_justification: The deletion only changes private Puppetflow configuration and sends no webhook.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the action configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches reusable snippets visible to the connected user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Puppetflow snippet metadata.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or publish snippets.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a snippet's editable code or visual graph.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private source from Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite or execute the snippet.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves allowed scopes, teams, and defaults for snippet creation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace configuration.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create or update a snippet.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a JavaScript snippet or updates an existing snippet draft.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores source inside Puppetflow and does not execute it or affect third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: An update overwrites the selected snippet's current draft after a concurrency check.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a visual snippet or updates an existing snippet graph.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores the graph inside Puppetflow and does not execute it or affect third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: An update overwrites the selected snippet's current draft after a concurrency check.

justifications.read_only_justification: Publishes the current snippet draft as a Puppetflow version.
justifications.open_world_justification: Publication remains within Puppetflow access controls.
justifications.destructive_justification: Version history is retained and no snippet data is deleted.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a snippet's publication state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes availability within Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Keeps the draft and version history so the snippet can be published again.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches existing flow runs and optionally returns their stored logs or code.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads execution records from Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not start, continue, or delete a run.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists recent execution records for one accessible flow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Puppetflow run history.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not start or modify any execution.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues and starts a browser automation with optional per-run inputs.
justifications.open_world_justification: The flow may interact with external websites, submit forms, or send messages.
justifications.destructive_justification: External actions performed by the browser automation may be irreversible.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an existing run and optionally includes its stored logs or code.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads execution data from Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not continue, rerun, or delete the execution.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the status, output, error, and duration of an existing run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads stored execution results from Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the run or its output.

justifications.read_only_justification: Signals a waiting browser automation to resume execution.
justifications.open_world_justification: The resumed flow may continue interacting with external websites or services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Actions performed after continuation may be irreversible.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists stored screenshots or downloads for an existing run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads artifact metadata from Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, alter, or delete artifact files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns metadata and a secure URL for the latest stored screenshot.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads an artifact already stored in Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the screenshot or run.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a secure URL for a selected stored run artifact.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only exposes an authenticated Puppetflow download route to the connected user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or remove the artifact.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a secure URL for an existing browser-session recording.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads recording availability from Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or delete the recording.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a secure URL for the last frame of an existing recording.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads an artifact already stored in Puppetflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or delete the recording frame.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves metadata and preferences for the connected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Puppetflow workspace settings.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify workspace configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates selected settings for the connected Puppetflow workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes remain within the private Puppetflow installation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Updates reversible configuration values without deleting workspace data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists workspace members visible to the connected user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private Puppetflow membership data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not add, remove, or update any member.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists teams in the connected Puppetflow workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace team metadata.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, rename, or change team membership.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one team and its accessible membership details.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace team data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter the team or its members.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a team inside the connected Puppetflow workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: The team remains private to the Puppetflow workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new team without deleting or replacing existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renames a team and its corresponding root folder.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes private Puppetflow workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: The rename is reversible and does not remove the team or its members.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds selected workspace users to a Puppetflow team.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes access within the private Puppetflow workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Preserves existing memberships and does not remove users.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the complete member list of a Puppetflow team.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes access within the private Puppetflow workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can remove existing members and revoke their team access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces all team assignments for one workspace member.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes access within the private Puppetflow workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can remove existing assignments and revoke the member's team access.

test_cases.description: Create a visual browser automation from a natural-language request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a visual flow named Status Check that opens the configured URL, captures a screenshot, and returns a successful result. Use a Flow Input for the URL.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a valid visual flow with a configurable URL input and reports its identifier and editor URL.

test_cases.description: Find an existing flow, inspect its inputs, run it, and retrieve the result.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find my Status Check flow, show me its expected Flow Inputs, run it with the configured default values, and return the final result.
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the flow, explains its inputs, starts one run, and returns the run status and result.

test_cases.description: Schedule an existing flow with a cron trigger.
test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule my Status Check flow to run every weekday at 9 AM in my configured timezone.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates an active cron trigger for the selected flow and summarizes the schedule and scope.

test_cases.description: Investigate a failed run and list its generated artifacts.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the latest failed run of Status Check, summarize its error and logs, and list any screenshots it produced.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the latest matching failure, a concise diagnostic summary, and available screenshot metadata.

test_cases.description: Create and publish a reusable visual snippet.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a visual snippet named Capture Current Page that takes a screenshot and returns its result, then publish it.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a valid reusable visual snippet, publishes its current draft, and reports the resulting version.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Puppetflow for a general knowledge question.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers without invoking Puppetflow because no browser automation or workspace operation is requested.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Puppetflow for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings are on my calendar tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Puppetflow because the app has no calendar-reading capability.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not treat Puppetflow as a generic local code execution environment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Run this Python script on my laptop and send me the terminal output.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Puppetflow because it cannot execute arbitrary local Python programs on the user's device.
